body:
alex: Heads-up — found a couple of broken in-page anchors after yesterday's sidebar reorder. Landing anchors jump to top of page instead of section. :grimacing:

 doc-bot: Automated docs scanner detected 2 broken anchors in /getting-started/installation (report #3845)

 maria: which anchors? can you paste links?

 alex: Sure — page: https://docs.redwood.inference/getting-started/installation
 Anchor 1: https://docs.redwood.inference/getting-started/installation#gpu-setup (404 jump)
 Anchor 2: https://docs.redwood.inference/getting-started/installation#post-install-tweaks

 sam: I saw this after the toc rewrite — anchors got renamed to kebab-case vs snake_case. Quick fix is frontmatter redirects or add html anchor tags. Example frontmatter snippet:
 ```
 redirect_from:
   - /getting-started/installation#gpu_setup
 ```
 (not exact path but shows idea)

 lina: I can open a tiny PR to add redirects for both anchors and update the anchor ids to new kebab-case. assigning to @maria for final signoff.

 maria: thanks Lina. please add a short changelog line and link to the issue. i'll review by EOD. also ping @sam for a quick edge-case check.

 alex: filed issue #3845 and added to docs board — https://internal.redwood/boards/docs/3845

 lina: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822 — adds redirects + updates anchor ids. assigned to maria, reviewers: sam, alex

 sam: quick glance looks fine. watch for cross-page links that reference the old anchor name (search/replace needed)

 maria: reviewing now.

 maria: approved and merged. :white_check_mark:

 doc-bot: PR #4822 merged, issue #3845 closed, deploy triggered to docs-staging

 alex: verified on staging — anchors now land correctly. thanks everyone :raised_hands:

 maria: I'll follow up with a short note in the docs owners channel about the sidebar rename and recommend a sweep of anchor names in affected sections.

 lina: will add a small unit test that flags in-page anchors missing corresponding id attributes during CI.

 alex: perfect. closing thread.
